name: Vector Tango
summary:
Take the controller's seat in Vector Tango, a mixed reality air traffic control game where a miniature airport comes to life in your space.

Draw paths through the air to guide propeller planes, jets and helicopters. Line up arrivals, release departures and route passing traffic to its next sector. Every clearance needs room: watch the approaches, read the flight strips and keep aircraft safely separated.
